categories_thin: Pools: no North Brunswick-based independent pool company could be confirmed. Every provider surfacing for the town is either out-of-town (Trinity Pools in Watchung, Stardust Pools in East Brunswick) or an Angi service-area listing with no address; the two Angi-only entries kept (S&R Pool & Spa, Best Pool Solutions) are unverified service listings. BBB and Angi pool pages are bot-blocked.

Restoration / water damage: still no independent North Brunswick operator. All candidates are service-area pages (Element, Northeast Power Dry, DHL Carpet, Phoenix Mitigation) or franchises/large brands excluded by the brief (SERVPRO, ServiceMaster); Element, DHL, Phoenix and Northeast Power Dry were dropped for this pass under the address rule rather than kept as unconfirmed locals.

Security installers: four North Brunswick-address firms only (AFA Protective, Accurate International Tech, Pro-Tec Systems, Aiko). BGS Security was dropped - it is an out-of-town firm running a service-area page, and Angi-only 'D&D Security Systems' has no published base.

Moving and storage: thin by nature - one mover with a North Brunswick address (Jersey Moving Pro) plus two small storage operators; Two Men and a Truck, U-Haul, Public Storage and College HUNKS are brand/franchise and excluded.
Siding / windows specialists: only A.W. Hobor & Sons is plausibly local, and its address is not published; every other window/siding candidate was a service-area page from a firm based elsewhere.
Garage doors: after removing the two iBegin-only listings that could not be confirmed, exactly one local firm remains (Advantage Garage Door, North Brunswick-based per its own site).

General contracting: improved - three Houzz/BestPros-listed North Brunswick builders (Van Dyk, VLS, ACE) were added. Still many iBegin entries are home-office/owner-operator addresses with no web presence, and no municipal licensed-contractor roster is available.
Landscaping: narrowed sharply by dropping lapsed state registrations - eleven firms remain, several with only a state registration and no published address or phone.
caveats: Zone rule now applied consistently: a business is listed only if a source places its own base in North Brunswick - a published North Brunswick street address, a NJ DCA home-improvement registration filed under North Brunswick, or a directory that assigns it to North Brunswick. Firms whose only North Brunswick presence is a service-area or SEO landing page for a company based elsewhere (or with no stated base) are excluded.

Excluded under that rule in this revision: Home Makeover, Double D Construction, DRR Painting, JDP Electric, Excel Pest Services, Lampsi Pools, BGS Security, Phoenix Mitigation, Element Water Damage Restoration, DHL Carpet Restoration, Quick Lock Services, JunkDoctors and Exquisite European Painting. Most are regional service-area marketers; several look like lead-generation sites rather than local shops.
Entries marked address Unknown are still in-zone by the rule (town-specific listing or state registration) but publish no street address; they need address resolution before any mail or drop-in work.

iBegin listings are numerous and give street addresses and phones, but that directory's data can be years old and its phone fields are unreliable; several shops appear under former names (Ben's Auto/High Velocity, Kingsborn/Oil Express, Kon Tai/Raj Auto). Treat iBegin-only entries as leads to confirm.

The Hadaa list derives from NJ DCA home-improvement registrations by municipality, not from a business directory. Its 'active through Mar 2027' and 'expired' statuses were re-read on both pages for this revision; all expired-registration firms were removed and are listed in data_gaps.

A cluster of firms share 2227 US-1 (CCS Mechanical, Above All Roofing Suite 227, Johnny Locksmith, Aspenn Tree Care #278), which looks like an office-suite/mailbox building rather than a retail shop location.
Many sole-proprietor trades entries carry residential street addresses because that is the business address the directory publishes; these are business listings, not personal details.

Excluded as chains/franchises although present in North Brunswick: Malouf Chevrolet/Cadillac, Malouf Ford/Lincoln, DCH Brunswick Toyota, Midas, Pep Boys, Goodyear, AutoZone, Maaco, Caliber Collision, Roto-Rooter, KeyMe, Minute Key, PGW Auto Glass, Public Storage, U-Haul, Mini U Storage, Two Men and a Truck, Stanley Steemer, SERVPRO, ServiceMaster, College HUNKS.

Phone numbers were spot-checked where the verifier flagged conflicts (Above All Roofing, AK Aire, 1844CarKeyz, Joe's Service Center, Broehl's, Denhard & Stuhl, Hometech); for the first three a corrected value was found and applied, for Joe's Service Center two current sources still disagree.
data_gaps: BBB (bbb.org) returned HTTP 403 on every category and profile page in this session; BBB values (Hometech Remodeling address/phone, Joe's Service Center phone, Aspenn and VSL listings) come from BBB pages as returned in search results, not from pages opened directly.

Angi, YellowPages, Superpages, Cylex, AllPages and localitybiz return HTTP 403 to automated fetches; their content was usable only as search-result listings, so entries sourced solely from them remain single-source.
Google Maps worked once (HVAC query) then served a bot check; no bypass attempted, so Maps was not used for the remaining categories.
Overpass API / OpenStreetMap was not reachable and was not pursued.

North Brunswick Township's own site was not searched for a licensed-business or economic-development directory; no municipal contractor roster was obtained, so the general-contractor list still relies on directories.
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory was not retrievable.

Removed as unconfirmable lead-generation or acquired sites: 'Middlesex County Pest Control' (its own pages describe it as a partner of Rest Easy Pest Control, whose BBB-listed headquarters is in Baldwin, NY - not a North Brunswick firm); 'Garage Door Repair North Brunswick' and 'Jamesburg Garage Doors Experts' (iBegin only, one shared shopping-centre address, second named for another town); 'Frank's Auto & Frame Specialists' (the NJ MVC auto-body facility list shows 980 Joyce Kilmer Ave under Caliber Bodyworks of NJ LLC, i.e. absorbed by an excluded chain); 'Napa Auto Repair' at 1184F Cozzens Ln (NAPA is a national brand network and no legal or trading name for the shop is published anywhere found - the shop needs identification before it can be contacted).

Removed as lapsed NJ DCA registrations with no current evidence of trading (registration expiry in brackets): Mike's Meticulous Design Landscaping (Mar 2016), Precision Landscape Services (Dec 2008), Nature's Escape Landscape Design (Dec 2010), A To Z Landscaping & Paving (Mar 2015), Glory Landscaping (Mar 2017), RAG Landscaping (Mar 2017), Affordable Landscaping LLC (May 2020), Trebol Landscaping & Tree Services (Mar 2021), Hodge Landscaping (Mar 2022), Twin Bros. Landscaping (Mar 2022), Cesars Landscaping (Mar 2023), Al's Maintenance Landscaping (Mar 2023), Greenstar Landscaping Design (Mar 2024), Chavez Lawn Services (Mar 2024), KC Merino Landscaping (Mar 2024), EDG Landscaping (Mar 2026). Where a firm resumes a current registration it can be reinstated.

Not verifiable in this session: whether High Velocity Auto's current address is 521 or 1184 Cozzens Ln; whether Arias Construction and ACE Construction (both 17 Erik Dr) are related; whether Jazz Construction Group is based in North Brunswick or Piscataway.
